.@BLMAtSchool School Board President Larry Miller will be bringing resolution forward at Tuesday's School Board meeting in support of National #BlackLivesMatter Week of Action in Our Schools. It is the 1st item on the committee agenda beginning at 6:30p.

https://t.co/r2XWEHADr1 https://t.co/hr9j0l5kun

.@BLMAtSchool If this is your 1st or 3rd time participating in #BlackLivesMatter Week of Action in Our Schools, MTEA strongly encourages all members to get involved. 

This will help you understand BLM principles, prepare for discussion, & plan lessons. https://t.co/YVFhuCg9sV

.@BLMAtSchool  Tonight there will be #BlackLivesMatter Week of Action Grab and Go, where members can learn about the Black Lives Matter principles, look over resources that can be used in the classroom, and take lessons. This session will be held at MTEA. https://t.co/4fEgGPpcOg

.@BLMAtSchool Next week is the The National #BlackLivesMatter Week of Action in Our Schools and Milwaukee has a full week of events planned so mark your calendars.

https://t.co/YVFhuCg9sV

.@BLMAtSchool Students Amplified - #BlackLivesMatterAtSchool in Milwaukee. Students from N. Division HS, Rufus King HS, & MKE HS of the Arts on panels discussed #BlackLivesMatter at School demands & how they apply to students' everyday experiences in MPS. https://t.co/iseDC2mb2C

.@BLMAtSchool It was students who taught history lesson at Humboldt Park School.

Students provided powerful slideshow with faces, names, & tragic stories that gave birth to #BlackLivesMatter movement during BlackLivesMatteratSchool program this afternoon. #DontreHamilton https://t.co/v1A1Z25i7H

.@BLMAtSchool Humboldt Park Day 2 #BlackLivesMatteratSchool Program. @LGMandelaBarnes joined & was featured speaker. Students presented powerful slideshow documenting tragic deaths behind birth of #BlackLivesMatter movement & what it means for schools. https://t.co/Uv9wan4PeI

.@BLMAtSchool @YRU_North_HS Students organize 3rd Annual Black Out March at North Division Community HS in concert with the #BlackLivesMatteratSchool Week of Action. 

https://t.co/eXsS0frVQm #BlackLivesMatter 

All photos: @JosephBrusky

Students drew, carved, & printed linocut social justice posters while investigating issues facing working people. Some referenced Fair Housing March in MKE, others carved poster demanding better school lunch, #BlackLivesMatter, & police brutality +more https://t.co/MLRufXJwsj
